seo.title: About Us — Bryan Zooler & Stéphane Pfeuti | OrganixEvents
seo.description: The people behind Organix: Bryan Zooler and Stéphane Pfeuti, a snowcat brought to North Macedonia, local partners and a growing family of sport and adventure experiences.

story.title: Around fifteen years in the making.
paragraphs: The Organix adventure has existed in different forms for around fifteen years, with Stéphane at its centre. Long before the snowcat, he was already organising trips to North Macedonia.
Bryan and Stéphane met through skiing — and through boots: during Bryan's racing career, Stéphane worked on his ski boots and custom footbeds.

Much more recently, the two of them created OrganixEvents Sàrl, bought a snowcat and brought it to North Macedonia. With two local partners they developed Wild Tracks, the local structure — and then kept going, into new sport and adventure experiences.
Alongside Organix, Bryan and Stéphane took over Art Feet in January 2026 and are developing Artfit Lab in Etoy — the same care for feet, boots and footbeds that brought them together.

people.intro: Bryan spent more than ten years in international ski cross, as a member of the Swiss ski cross team. Racing took him to mountains all over the world — and taught him what makes a day in the mountains work.
people.text: Since then, he has launched sport, mountain and adventure projects, as well as his own businesses. Today, he puts that field experience to work for Organix adventures.
facts: Former member of the Swiss ski cross team
Entrepreneur — sport, mountain and adventure projects

people.intro: Stéphane has been the pillar of Organix for around fifteen years — and for just as long, he has been travelling to, working in and building relationships in North Macedonia.
people.text: He knows the places, the people and how to make things run on the ground. His background in bootfitting and footbeds is how he and Bryan first met.
facts: Around 15 years at the heart of Organix

local.title: Local knowledge matters.
local.text: Organix works with the people who really know the terrain. We bring the structure, the organisation, the experience and the network; our local partners bring their knowledge of the place. Together, that's what makes a trip work.

final.title: Let's build the next adventure.
